Manually evaluating the generated code is impractical, which calls for the need for automatic metrics. The above mentioned benchmarks all provide test cases for execution-based evaluation, where metrics such as pass@k (Chen et al., 2021), n@k , test case average , and execution accuracy ) can be used. For non-executable code, metrics like BLEU , ROUGE are used...
pass@k is used as the evaluation metric, which calculates the proportion of problems that can be correctly answered with k tries.
